verdict.rationale: WooCommerce ships its own first-party CLI, WC-CLI, for managing stores from the command line. A probe confirms official CLI documentation at developer.woocommerce.com. That covers the core of the story; the depth of the CLI is thinly evidenced. missing for 10: documented command coverage and depth (e.g., products/orders operations), evidence of machine-readable output or agent-friendly scripting for AI-native workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: WooCommerce CLI (WC-CLI) offers an efficient way to manage WooCommerce (WC) stores via the command line.
